additionalDocuments.label: SAMANA Ocean Bay · original official building floorplates

review.imagery: Fifteen project renders were visually reviewed. Nine native brochure views and six current-gallery scenes cover both buildings, frontage, home interiors, gym, shared pools, family lawn, sunken lounge, walkway and central courtyard. Duplicate cropped versions and generic beach/people photographs are excluded. The complete two-building exterior supplies the card and hero. Interior concepts remain unit-unspecific. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: One hundred distinct home sheets and six floorplates preserve the source keys. Brochure pages 70–71 duplicate 68–69. Page 62 repeats B209, and page 117 says Tower B but prints A703. These references need developer confirmation. Numerical unit areas are absent. Confirm the approved floor, unit, configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. All 102 physical home-drawing pages were visually reviewed in full-sheet composites, as were all six official floorplates. The two duplicate pairs were additionally confirmed by exact rendered-file SHA-256 equality. Each of the remaining 100 sheets retains its original physical page. The repeated B209 key and Tower B/A703 mismatch remain visible. Room dimensions are not summed into an invented home area. Current page six-floor wording versus source eighth-floor drawings remains unresolved.
review.location: Complete original brochure travel panel page 8 and regional map page 9 were visually reviewed. Source travel differences remain explicit. The official q value 25.297735048921336, 55.32043367116447 is saved with source hash and six-place rounding. The future blue route is qualified. No road distance, live route or precise entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML, original official brochure, original official floorplate pack and fact sheet retain retrieval receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image origins, complete sheets, separate original PDFs and physical-page links remain available. Protected ownership, completed text research and source conflicts are preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, resolution of the repeated B209 and Tower B/A703 references, confirmation of six-floor versus eighth-floor source scope, approved final fitout, a verified entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
